title: Gluten-Free Cookies
description: Chewy gluten-free chocolate chip cookies with molasses for a deep, caramel flavour. Chill the dough 30 minutes. Makes about 20.

ingredients.item: xanthan gum (only if your blend has none)
unsalted butter, melted and slightly cooled

steps: Whisk the gluten-free flour, xanthan gum (if needed), baking soda and salt in a bowl.
In a large bowl, whisk the melted butter with the brown sugar, granulated sugar and molasses until glossy. Whisk in the egg, yolk and vanilla.
Stir in the dry ingredients until smooth, then fold in the chocolate chips.
Cover and chill the dough for at least 30 minutes (up to 2 days). Gluten-free flour needs this time to absorb moisture; skip it and the cookies spread and taste gritty.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment. Scoop 2-tbsp balls of dough about 6 cm apart.
Bake one sheet at a time for 10–12 minutes, until the edges are set and the tops crackle but the centres are still soft.
Cool on the sheet for 10 minutes, since they're fragile while warm, then move to a rack.
